title: koeleria cristata var. tokiensis
intro: Koeleria cristata var. tokiensis, commonly known as Japanese hair grass or Japanese June grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine, particularly in East Asian cultures, to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Koeleria cristata var. tokiensis include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of this plant can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, that have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
